facts.text: Edgefield sits in northwestern Louisiana’s Red River Parish, a region once home to the Caddo peoples who built sophisticated agricultural villages and mound‑building ceremonies.
During the American Civil War, the area around Edgefield suffered widespread devastation to plantations and infrastructure, echoing the broader turmoil of Red River Parish.
Edgefield is officially classified as a village, a designation that reflects its small size and tight‑knit community within Red River Parish.
The Village of Edgefield launched a new official website on December 18, 2023, offering residents a centralized hub for news and alerts.
Every August, Edgefield participates in Water Quality Awareness Month, reminding residents that clean water is essential for daily life—from coffee to garden irrigation.
Edgefield’s local water supply is highlighted on the village website, where residents can learn conservation tips that help save both water and money.
